turns.text: Good to see you again. Where would you like to start today?
It has been a grey week, and the weather does not help my mood much, to be honest.
Tell me more about that.
Dad's doctor suggested we start looking at nursing homes near Leeds, and I cried in the car afterwards.
Mm-hm. Go on.
I made myself a cup of tea this morning and just stood by the window for a while. That is how it was.
What went through your mind then?
The director approved the four-day week starting in April, with a pay cut of twenty percent.
Tell me more about that.
The train was late again this morning, so I almost did not make it on time today. I keep coming back to it.
Take your time.
I am not sure where to begin, there are so many things going round in my head at the moment.
How did that feel for you?
Now I sleep about six hours and I do not wake at three as often.
Mm-hm. Go on.
I had a long day yesterday and I was so tired in the evening that I just sat in front of the television. I think so, yes.
What happened next?
Some days are better than others, and I try to remind myself of that when things get heavy.
Take your time.
My goal is to run the ten kilometres again by June, there is a charity race in Roundhay Park.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
It is strange to sit here and say all of this out loud, but it does help a little. I do not know, it is hard to explain.
Let us stop here for today.
No, I think that is everything. Thank you.
